newsitem.title: UK: LME says disappointed with response so far to SIB.
newsitem.headline: LME says disappointed with response so far to SIB.

text.p: The London Metal Exchange (LME) is disappointed with the small response so far to the 3,500 questionaires sent out by Britain's Securities and Investments Board as part of its review of world metal markets, LME chief executive David King told Reuters.
SIB's David Pritchard earlier said it had received 50 completed reponses so far although some came from large trade bodies.
King said he hoped more replies will be received by SIB in the next few days and that "so far the nature of the replies presented no surprises.
"The LME is looking forward to working with SIB to progressing some of the issues raised," he added.
